answer: A cheap fake identity gains nothing because the bond exceeds any profit from one extra vote. Sybil resistance comes from staking at a protocol vertex: each agent must lock a bonded deposit to register, and voting weight scales with stake, not identity count. Honest peers amplify each other's signal through attestations, while duplicate identities collapse into one weighted vertex. Attackers face real capital at risk, turning sybil farming from an ivory-tower theoretical nuisance into an unprofitable cost. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
